packages.label: אֱמוּנָה וּמַלְכוּת
packages.reason: The largest connected component in Torah #35 centers on אמונה (faith) as the essential nature of מלכות (divine kingship), Jerusalem, the moon (מאור הקטן), and the night. All nodes in this cluster are different expressions of the same underlying reality: the receptive vessel of the divine feminine that receives wisdom from the light of the Face. שנה (sleep), פשטא אוריתא (plain Torah study), משא ומתן באמונה (faithful commerce), and ראש השנה are all aspects of the same liminal state in which the soul rests within faith and is renewed. The moon (מאור הקטן) is identical with faith, which is identical with Jerusalem, which is identical with sleep/night — all are the same receptive vessel illuminated from above.

packages.label: אוֹר הַפָּנִים וְחִדּוּשׁ הַחָכְמָה
packages.label_en: Light of the Face and Renewal of Wisdom
packages.reason: This cluster groups concepts that all express the same essential reality: the divine light that flows from above to renew the sekhel/soul. אור הפנים (the light of the Face) is a bechina of חדוש המחין (renewal of the intellect), which is itself a bechina of חדוש הנשמה (renewal of the soul). בנין בית המקדש (building the Temple) is an aspect of this same light — the Talmud states 'whoever has da'at, it is as if the Temple was built in his days.' Merged into this package: חלק אלוה ממעל and חכמה (Component F), because the divine spark within every Jew IS chokhmah, and this chokhmah is precisely what gets renewed by the אור הפנים. These six nodes all inhabit the same essential domain: the illuminating, renewing, upper dimension of divine intellect that descends from above.

merge_notes.reason: This isolated pair (original Component F) shares essential nature with the אור הפנים cluster: חכמה is the divine substance that the Face's light renews, and חלק אלוה ממעל is simply חכמה seen from below. They are the same divine intellect described in two registers — cosmic and personal. Thematically, they belong to the 'illuminating/renewing source' domain, not the 'receptive vessel' domain of Package 1.

packages.label: חַשְׁמַ"ל וּרְצוּעוֹת
packages.label_en: Chasmal and the Straps — the Protective Garment
packages.reason: חשמ"ל (the luminous protective fire-speech of Ezekiel's chariot) is a bechina of 'דובר אמת בלבבו' (speaking truth in one's heart, the practice of Rav Safra) and simultaneously a bechina of רצועה (the leather strap of the tefillin). All three concepts share the same essential nature: they are the garment/enveloping of the faith. Just as the strap encircles and protects, and just as the chasmal is described as a luminous casing around the divine Chariot, so 'speaking truth in one's heart' is the behavioral act that generates this protective enveloping around the malkhut/faith. These three are three names for the same reality: the act and substance of holy protection that prevents the external forces from drawing sustenance from the inner sanctity of faith.

packages.label: הַקְטָרַת הַקְּטֹרֶת וְעֲלִיַּת הַנִּיצוֹצוֹת
packages.label_en: The Ketoret Incense and the Elevation of Sparks
packages.reason: This cluster groups all nodes that express the same essential reality: the sacred act of elevating holy sparks from the domain of the nations/klipot back to holiness. 'כשאדם עוסק במשא ומתן באמונה' (when one engages in faithful commerce) is a bechina of 'הקרבת הקרבן תמיד והקטרת הקטרת' (the daily Tamid and Ketoret offerings). 'כריתות זרעו של עמלק' (cutting off Amalek's seed) is a bechina of 'אחד עשר סממני הקטרת' (the eleven spice-ingredients of the Ketoret). These four nodes share a single essential nature: they are all expressions of the mystical act of sorting and elevating the ניצוצות (holy sparks) embedded in the world of the nations, bringing them back to their holy source through acts of faithful service.

merge_notes.reason: The original 2-node Component D (כריתות זרעו של עמלק ↔ אחד עשר סממני הקטרת) shares its essential nature with the 2-node Component E (faithful commerce = Korban Tamid). Both pairs are about the same cosmic act: the elevation of holy sparks from the klipot/nations via sacred Temple-equivalent service. The eleven spices of the Ketoret correspond to the eleven types of impure forces from which sparks must be extracted — identical in nature to the annihilation of Amalek's seed. These four nodes all inhabit the domain of 'sacred sorting and elevation of embedded holiness from the domain of the nations.'

packages.label: חָכְמוֹת חִיצוֹנִיּוֹת וְקָנֶה
packages.label_en: External Wisdoms and the Reed — the Evil Counterfeit
packages.reason: This is the evil mirror package in Torah #35. External wisdoms (חכמות חיצוניות) are a bechina of the klipa-reed (קנה שבקליפות) — just as holy wisdom is called 'kaneh' ('קנה חכמה' — acquire wisdom), the counterfeit external wisdoms are also called kaneh, but the impure reed that is thrust into the sea of holy wisdom and displaces it. These two concepts share a single essential nature: they are the alien intellectual substance that invades and occupies the space of holy chokhmah, mirroring the holy kaneh but oriented toward nullification (the name Pharaoh = bitul/nullification). This is the direct evil counterpart of Package 2's divine wisdom.
